source: pod-jinawong r11 (gateway 3d370131), app 0.1.1-alpha.2.wincu.8 (dbc4dc3) on macOS 26.6.2, task ec82ed05 "TradingView: draw a new BTC channel touching real peaks". Round receipts (computer-requests), no screenshots; installed apps trimmed, account name replaced. The recorded apps list stops at 100 entries; TradingView (the app this task opened) is added back.

rev1.command: In TradingView BTCUSDT 1D chart: remove the existing parallel channel, turn on Magnet mode, then draw a new parallel channel on the current downtrend since early October, anchoring the first line exactly on the real swing highs (October peak ~87.5k and the next lower high) and dragging the parallel line to the real swing low, so candle wicks touch the lines
rev1.note: GetPod was in front: the first observation came back withheld (application "unapproved"), and the model spent its first action reopening TradingView.

rev3.command: Close the "Time to upgrade?" ad popup (Close ad button), then remove the old channel by pressing "Undo create parallel channel" in the top toolbar. Do NOT press the indicator legend "Remove" buttons (they delete CDC ActionZone / RSI indicators). Then continue: turn on Magnet mode and draw a new parallel channel on the downtrend since early October anchored on the real swing highs (October peak ~87.5k and the next lower high) with the parallel line on the real swing low.
